source_acquisition.search_note: The visual_source_inventory.csv row for this paper is unresolved and lists danyalrehman/FALCON and transferable-samplers/transferable-samplers. The PDF abstract explicitly links https://github.com/danyalrehman/FALCON; gh api returned 404 and the author public-repository list had no same-named repository, so no FALCON README, TeX, plot generator, table generator, or editable figure source was available. The local corpus/visual_sources/iclr-2026-927309b0632d/ directory is absent. Appendix F.1 links transferable-samplers/transferable-samplers for the SBG baseline; its recursive tree has related baseline plotting utilities but no FALCON paper composition or TeX/TikZ/PGF/SVG source. Therefore the status is partial_visual_source, selected_repository is null, and the listed scripts are contextual rather than exact FALCON sources.

paper_style.palette_strategy: 主文比较图使用黑、橙、紫、粉的离散方法色；能量直方图固定 True data/Proposal/Proposal (reweighted) 的橙、粉、紫语义；regularization/schedule 消融使用紫到橙的序列；Ramachandran 与 angular prediction 热图统一使用浅黄到深紫/黑的 Free energy / kBT sequential scale。Figure 1 是紫/蓝的概念流程图。HEX 均从 PDF 渲染估计，未找到 FALCON 图源中的 exact HEX。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 正文、caption 和表格规则是 PDF 字体/矢量对象；主文折线、柱状和直方图主要由矢量路径组成。Figures 8–11、14–17 的热图资源是栅格图像并叠加向量坐标与色条，整体为 mixed output。pdfimages 显示这些资源的有效分辨率至少 198 dpi，满足本审计的至少 180 dpi 检查要求。
paper_style.style_consistency: 所有主文/附录对象共享 ICLR 单栏版式、Nimbus/Computer Modern 字体层级和克制的 caption 系统。图表的 purple/magenta/orange family 在比较与消融中反复出现，热图共享 colorbar 和角度坐标；但 inset 图和十面板热图字号偏小，颜色承担了多数方法/密度语义，灰度和色弱冗余不足。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Flow map learns from biased data, with SNIS re-weighting generated samples consistent with the Boltzmann distribution, approaching equality with infinite samples under mild regularity conditions.

color.semantic_mapping: Source/biased/debiased density tones, flow paths, and directional arrows; all HEX values are estimated from the rendered PDF.

encodings.color: Density tone and blue arrows distinguish source/target states and transport direction.
encodings.shape: Density contours versus flow paths versus the SNIS formula box.
encodings.line: Path direction arrows encode the processing order.
encodings.facet: Source → biased target → SNIS → debiased target.
encodings.text: Labels x0, xs, xt, x1, v(xs,s), and uθ(xs,s,t) name the states and vector fields.

figures.data_and_statistics: Conceptual density shapes and many flow paths show the source-to-target map; the boxed SNIS expression shows normalized reweighting. No sample denominator, empirical uncertainty, or numerical metric is plotted.
figures.evidence_relation: Links the BG/SNIS problem in §§1–2 and Eqs. 1–2 to the quantitative efficiency and quality objects in Figure 2 and Tables 2–5.
design_strengths: A single horizontal causal interface combines biased source, transport, statistical correction, and target.
Arrow direction and variable labels make the method hand-off legible without axes.
design_weaknesses: Many translucent paths overlap at the small conference width.
The diagram does not quantify proposal likelihood, energy, or SNIS weight dispersion.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a page-width biased-source → correction → target flow diagram to turn a theoretical interface into the experiment entry point, placing state variables beside the arrows.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Performance-inference time comparison between NFs and CNFs for 10^4 dipeptide samples.

color.semantic_mapping: FALCON, SBG, and three DiT solver/trace variants are separated by method colors and marker/line combinations.

encodings.x: Evaluation Time, GPU Hours on a log scale.
encodings.line: Method curves with vertical error bars.
encodings.text: Legend names FALCON, SBG (Tan et al.), DiT euler (exact), DiT dopri5 (exact), and DiT dopri5 (Hutch).

figures.data_and_statistics: Five method/solver series compare T-W2 against evaluation time for 10^4 dipeptide samples. Error bars are visible but their aggregation is not defined by the caption; training time is not separated.
figures.evidence_relation: Extends the introduction claim that CNF likelihood costs many function evaluations; Table 4 supplies cumulative cost, while Table 5 and Figure 13 split the comparison by NFE and solver.
design_strengths: Log time compresses multiple cost orders into a single frontier.
A common T-W2 axis makes comparable-quality operating points easy to locate.
design_weaknesses: The inset is crowded by five series, markers, and error bars.
No operating point or numeric annotation is shown, so the “two orders faster” reading requires visual estimation.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair a log-cost x-axis with task quality and a companion numeric table so a solver frontier is not interpreted from the inset alone.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: True MD energy distribution with best FALCON unweighted and re-sampled proposals for alanine dipeptide (left), tri-alanine (center left), and alanine tetrapeptide (center right), and hexa-alanine (right).

color.semantic_mapping: True data, Proposal, and Proposal (reweighted) are encoded by orange, pink, and purple filled/step histograms.

encodings.x: Energy E(x), with a panel-specific range.
encodings.shape: Histogram/step marks for each sample set.
encodings.facet: Four molecular systems and their step counts as panel titles.
encodings.text: Legend in the first panel names the three distributions.

figures.data_and_statistics: Four systems use overlaid density histograms; the panel titles show 4, 8, 8, and 16 steps. No formal distance, seed dispersion, or confidence interval is plotted.
figures.evidence_relation: Adds local energy-shape evidence to Tables 2–3 and connects the SNIS/debiasing mechanism in Figure 1 to the later Ramachandran mode checks.
design_strengths: A common three-distribution grammar makes proposal versus reweighted proposal easy to compare with True data.
Facet titles expose the actual inference steps.
design_weaknesses: Different panel ranges prevent direct comparison of peak heights across molecules.
Semi-transparent overlap is difficult to distinguish in grayscale or dense modes.
figures.reusable_pattern: Overlay true, uncorrected proposal, and reweighted proposal distributions in fixed small multiples, with the computational step count in each panel title.

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Performance with additional samples.

color.semantic_mapping: SBG and FALCON are shown as two sample-budget curves.

encodings.x: Number of Samples Generated, N_t, on a log scale.
encodings.line: Sample-budget curves with vertical error bars.
encodings.text: Legend names SBG and FALCON; a vertical dashed budget/reference line marks the comparison budget.

figures.data_and_statistics: The plot varies generated sample count and reports E-W2 for SBG and FALCON. Appendix F.1 states three SBG draws per sample count; the figure does not expose the complete sample denominator or aggregation in its caption.
figures.evidence_relation: Supports the claim that increasing SBG to 5 × 10^6 samples does not remove the E-W2 gap, complementing Table 3, Table 4, and Figure 2.
design_strengths: A log sample-budget axis makes diminishing returns visible.
The dashed budget reference and error bars link sample cost to quality.
design_weaknesses: Small size makes the curves and error bars easy to conflate.
E-W2 is the only metric, so the panel cannot establish an all-metrics advantage alone.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a log sample-budget versus quality curve to test whether more samples close a gap, and define draw count and error bars in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: Improved proposal and re-weighted sample energies with increased steps for alanine dipeptide.

color.semantic_mapping: True data, Proposal, and Proposal (reweighted) retain Figure 3 color semantics.

encodings.x: Energy E(x), with a panel-specific range.
encodings.text: Legend in the first panel names the three distributions.

design_strengths: The fixed palette and facets isolate the step-count change.
The progression from 1 to 8 steps gives a direct shape-level diagnostic.
design_weaknesses: Overlaid fills hide small modes.
Caption and panel axes do not report binning or replicate aggregation.

figures.label: Figure 6

caption.text: Figure 6: Performance trade-off with increasing regularization.

color.semantic_mapping: Four step settings (2, 4, 8, 16) use a purple-to-orange categorical sequence.

plot_grammar.legend_placement: lower left and upper right by panel

encodings.x: Regularization λr on a log scale.
encodings.y: ESS (log y in left panel) and T-W2 (linear y in right panel).
encodings.line: Four step-specific curves with vertical error bars.
encodings.facet: Two panels encode ESS and T-W2.
encodings.text: Axis titles and separate legends identify the two metrics and four step series.

figures.data_and_statistics: The visible sweep covers λr values from the appendix set {10^0, 10^1, 10^2, 10^3, 10^4, 10^5}, with the rendered main plot mainly labeled through 10^4. Curves represent the two metrics across four step counts; the paper reports three trained seeds for quantitative experiments.
figures.evidence_relation: Connects Eq. 8–9’s invertibility regularization to the chosen λr=10 setting, and to Figure 12’s auxiliary reverse-loss diagnostic.
design_strengths: Log λr reveals a cross-order-of-magnitude trade-off.
Separate metric panels avoid overlaying ESS and T-W2 on one scale.
design_weaknesses: The two panels use different y scales, which makes cross-panel visual intuition risky.
The short caption omits metric names, step series, sweep range, and error-bar definition.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use side-by-side metric panels for regularization trade-offs, while stating the complete sweep and selected operating point in the caption or table.

caption.text: Figure 7: Performance vs. choice of inference schedule.

encodings.y: T-W2 (linear left panel) and E-W2 (log right panel).

design_weaknesses: Log E-W2 and linear T-W2 should not be compared by bar height alone.
Abbreviations and error aggregation are delegated to the body and appendix.

figures.label: Figure 12

caption.text: Figure 12: Auxiliary model loss from reflow target training on forward flow.

color.semantic_mapping: Raw reverse-loss trace is light purple; 0.99 EMA is dark purple.

encodings.y: Training Loss on a logarithmic scale.
encodings.shape: Raw and EMA are visually distinct line series.
encodings.text: Legend names Reversible Loss Curve (Raw) and Reversible Loss Curve (0.99 EMA).

figures.data_and_statistics: A raw noisy loss and a smoothed 0.99 EMA loss are shown over 1000 epochs on a log y scale. The body specifies frozen forward training and 2 × 10^5 prior-target pairs; recovered-latent ℓ2 error is not plotted.
figures.evidence_relation: Provides a local practical reverse-map diagnostic for the Linv mechanism in Figure 6; it does not replace the ideal conditions of Propositions 1–2 or establish a global likelihood bound.
design_strengths: Log scaling exposes a long loss descent and preserves the noisy-versus-trend distinction.
The raw/EMA pairing separates observation smoothing from a second experiment.
design_weaknesses: The caption omits the EMA definition, training-set size, and final reverse error.
One auxiliary setting cannot establish global invertibility.
figures.reusable_pattern: Plot raw and smoothed auxiliary losses together, while reporting the smoothing parameter and a final interpretable reconstruction error.

figures.label: Figure 13

caption.text: Figure 13: Performance of FALCON vs. our DiT CNFs as a function of NFEs.

color.semantic_mapping: FALCON and three DiT Euler/Dopri5 exact/Hutch variants use distinct method colors.

encodings.x: Number of Function Evaluations, NFE, on a log scale.
encodings.line: Solver curves with vertical error bars.
encodings.text: Legend identifies FALCON, DiT euler (exact), DiT dopri5 (exact), and DiT dopri5 (Hutch).

figures.data_and_statistics: Four solver series relate NFE to T-W2. Body text identifies FALCON 4-step and 8-step operating comparisons, while the plot does not annotate tolerance, sample count, or exact match points.
figures.evidence_relation: Splits Figure 2’s time claim into an NFE frontier and pairs with Table 5’s 4–16 versus 200–265 NFE values and Appendix D solver settings.
design_strengths: Log NFE places few-step and adaptive solver regimes on one axis.
Color and legend preserve solver identity across the error-bar curves.
design_weaknesses: Operating points and uncertainty aggregation are not numerically annotated.
NFE still needs Figure 2 and Table 4 to translate into wall-clock cost.
figures.reusable_pattern: Treat computational budget as a log x-axis, keep the task metric on y, and pin tolerance and matching operating points in a companion table.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Related method overview

tables.uncertainty: Capability cells are categorical check/cross marks; no uncertainty, rank, or repeat statistic.
tables.data_and_statistics: Seven method rows (BioEmu, FlowMaps, TBG, RegFlow, Prose, FFFlows, FALCON) and four capability columns: Invertible, Regression-loss, Few Step, FreeForm Arch. FALCON is checked in all four capability columns.
tables.evidence_relation: Positions methods in the Related Work taxonomy before Tables 2–5 test sampling quality and cost.
design_strengths: Four capability columns are compact and fast to scan.
The FALCON row’s all-check pattern is visually salient without a large graphic.
design_weaknesses: No citation/version or decision rule supports each capability mark.
Color plus ✓/✗ is not fully safe for grayscale printing.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a small capability matrix to define comparison dimensions, then reserve numeric tables for empirical evidence.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Results on alanine dipeptide. Best results are bolded, with second-best underlined.

tables.uncertainty: Most cells are points or mean ± SD; dashes mean unavailable, and SBG SMC ESS is explicitly invalid. ↑/↓ arrows define metric direction.
tables.data_and_statistics: Nine algorithm rows report ESS, E-W2, and T-W2 for ALDP. Values include FALCON ESS 0.067 ± 0.013, E-W2 0.225 ± 0.104, T-W2 0.402 ± 0.021; FALCON-A has ESS 0.097 ± 0.007, E-W2 0.512 ± 0.038, T-W2 0.180 ± 0.005; ECNF++ has the best ESS 0.275 ± 0.010.
tables.evidence_relation: Primary ALDP numeric anchor for Figure 3/5 distributions, Figure 2/4 costs and sample budget, and Table 5’s Dopri5 comparison; different FALCON variants win different metrics.
design_strengths: Metric arrows and bold/underline provide a stable comparison grammar.
FALCON variants remain visible instead of collapsing to one selected row.
design_weaknesses: Method abbreviations, ESS normalization, and unavailable cells require body definitions.
Mixed point estimates and mean ± SD complicate row-level visual comparison.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use metric-direction arrows, explicit best/second-best formatting, and an unavailable symbol while preserving method variants.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Quantitative results on tri-alanine (AL3), alanine tetrapeptide (AL4), and hexa-alanine (AL6). Baseline methods presented with SNIS, unless stated otherwise. Evaluations are conducted over 2 × 10^5 samples.

tables.uncertainty: Most quality cells are mean ± SD over the reported model seeds; baselines can be points or dashes. ↑/↓ arrows define direction. The caption states 2 × 10^5 evaluations.
tables.data_and_statistics: Six algorithm rows span three dataset groups (AL3, AL4, AL6), each with ESS, E-W2, and T-W2. Selected anchors: AL3 FALCON E-W2 0.544 ± 0.013; AL4 FALCON ESS 0.055 ± 0.003 and E-W2 0.686 ± 0.047; AL6 FALCON E-W2 0.892 ± 0.311; FALCON-A supplies different ESS/T-W2 points.
tables.evidence_relation: Main scalability table; Figures 3 and 8–11/15–17 supply distribution-level context, while Table 4 supplies cumulative cost. The table caption’s 2 × 10^5 conflicts with Appendix D.1’s 10^4 proposal-sample wording and must remain an audit caveat.
design_strengths: Dataset groups and metric subcolumns put size scaling and local/global quality on one surface.
Consistent FALCON row highlighting carries over from Table 2.
design_weaknesses: Ten columns force small type and dense cross-dataset scanning.
The sample-budget conflict with Appendix D.1 weakens direct reproduction.
tables.reusable_pattern: Group columns by dataset size and metrics by local/global meaning, with one highlighting and uncertainty grammar across all groups.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Cumulative training + inference time across flows. 2 × 10^5 samples evaluated with (atol = rtol = 10^−5 for our CNF and 4-step FALCON). All experiments were conducted on a NVIDIA L40S with batch size 1024.

tables.uncertainty: Point estimates only; no error, repeat count, or significance display. The table does not put the time unit in a dedicated header.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four molecular systems compare cumulative training + inference time for ECNF++, SBG, DiT CNF (Ours), and FALCON (Ours). FALCON times are 7.65, 11.45, 18.84, and 25.76 across ALDP, AL3, AL4, and AL6. Hardware is NVIDIA L40S with batch size 1024.
tables.evidence_relation: Turns Figure 2’s inference-time comparison into a system-level cumulative cost table and complements Table 5 NFE and Figure 13 solver curves.
design_strengths: Hardware, batch size, tolerance, and sample budget appear in the caption.
Rows cover the same four molecular systems used by the main quality objects.
design_weaknesses: Time units are implied rather than explicit in the table header.
No best highlight, training budget, or repeat variability slows audit of cost differences.
tables.reusable_pattern: State units, hardware, sample budget, and training/inference boundary directly in a system-cost table, with a visible low-cost highlight.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Quantitative results on alanine dipeptide, tri-alanine, alanine tetrapeptide, and hexa-alanine compared to our Dopri5-integrated CNFs. Evaluations were conducted over 2 × 10^5 points across methods.

tables.uncertainty: ESS, E-W2, and T-W2 are mean ± SD; NFE is an integer. ↑/↓ arrows define metric direction; no best/second-best or cell-color highlighting.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four system row groups pair FALCON-Dopri5 with FALCON. NFE pairs are 257/4 (ALDP), 265/8 (AL3), 200/8 (AL4), and 207/16 (AL6), with quality columns for ESS, E-W2, and T-W2.
tables.evidence_relation: Core evidence for the 4–16 versus 200–265 NFE claim; ties Figure 2/13 solver cost to Figure 5 step trade-off. Its 2 × 10^5 points caption should be read with the Appendix D.1 sample-budget discrepancy.
design_strengths: System row groups put high-NFE and few-step methods in direct pairs.
Quality uncertainty and NFE share one row-level audit surface.
design_weaknesses: No wall-clock column or best highlight is provided.
The reader must track three metric directions and reconcile the separate sample-budget wording.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair a high-accuracy solver with a few-step solver per system and report quality, NFE, budget, and uncertainty together.

caption.text: Table 6: Overview of FALCON configurations across datasets.

tables.uncertainty: Architecture points only; no uncertainty, rank, optimizer, split, or solver statistic.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four datasets share Hidden Size 192, Blocks 6, Heads 6, Cond. Dim. 64, and Parameters 3.2M. Values are constant across ALDP, AL3, AL4, and AL6.
tables.evidence_relation: Separates model capacity from Tables 2–5 quality results and connects Appendix D.1 architecture details to Figures 3, 6, and 8–17.
design_strengths: Identical rows make cross-dataset capacity control immediately visible.
The narrow table avoids mixing architecture with performance metrics.
design_weaknesses: Optimizer, EMA, augmentation, data split, and solver settings remain outside the table.

tables.reusable_pattern: Use a compact architecture table to hold capacity constant across datasets and keep optimizer/split/scheduler details in the implementation section.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 建立 biased source → flow map → SNIS → debiased target 的因果接口；Figure 2 把接口接到时间质量 frontier；Tables 2–5 与 Figures 3–7 给出质量、分布和成本/消融；Figures 8–17 在附录展开数据覆盖、反向诊断和角度预测。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Caption 均以 Figure/Table 编号加短标题开头，随后按 setup、panel mapping、comparison 或 high-level finding 补充。主文 Figure 4/6/7 和附录 Figure 12–17 的 caption 很短，常需正文恢复轴、误差和样本预算；Figure 11 的 panel count 与实物不一致。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 结果表用 ↑/↓ 指标方向、两层 dataset/metric header、mean ± SD 和 bold/underline best/second-best；Table 1 用 capability 列，Table 4 用方法列，Table 5 用 system row groups，Table 6 用 architecture columns。规则以 minimal/booktabs 和少量 partial-grid 为主。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 与 Eqs. 1–9 解释 flow/SNIS/Linv；Figures 5–7 将 steps、λr 和 schedule 变成可见消融；Tables 2–5 将这些选择绑定到 ESS/E-W2/T-W2、NFE 与累计时间；Figure 12 只提供局部 reverse-loss 实证边界。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 Figures 1–7、Tables 1–5 负责方法、主结果和成本；Appendix Table 6 固定模型容量，Figures 8–11 给出 train/test coverage，Figures 12–13 给出 reverse/NFE diagnostics，Figures 14–17 给出 angle-wise prediction checks。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF 字体对象显示 Nimbus Roman No9 L、Computer Modern、DejaVu Sans/STIX 与 Inconsolata 子系统。表体和 inset 图文字约 5–9 pt，整体层级一致，但小 inset legend、十面板 heatmap 和角度下标降低可读性。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 橙/粉/紫稳定编码 distribution variants，黑/橙/紫/粉编码 solver/method，紫到橙编码 steps/schedules，浅黄到深紫/黑编码 free-energy heatmaps。颜色通常没有形状或线型的充分冗余，灰度与色弱打印需要改进。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 biased source、flow map、SNIS 和 debiased target 的页宽流程图把理论接口连接到实验。
用固定 True data/Proposal/Proposal (reweighted) histogram 语法和 step small multiples同时展示分布形状与计算旋钮。
把指标方向、best/second-best、seed dispersion、sample budget、NFE 和累计成本放到相邻 Tables 2–5，形成 quality–cost decision surface。
在 train/test 与 prediction heatmaps 中复用 shared free-energy colorbar、角度坐标和 torsion index，形成可追溯的高维结构矩阵。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：方法从 biased BG 数据到 SNIS-debiased target 的视觉入口。
Figure 2 与 Tables 4–5：分别承载 time frontier、累计系统成本和 NFE/quality 配对数字。
Table 3 与 Figure 3：分别承载 larger-peptide 数值质量和四系统 energy-shape sanity check。
Figures 8–11 与 14–17：将 train/test coverage 与 angle-wise prediction 对齐，限定 qualitative scalability claim。
failure_patterns: Inset 图、legend 和 error bars 偏小，且 Figure 2/4/6/7/12/13 缺少完整 operating-point 与误差定义。
Figure 3/5 的 binning/范围、Figure 6/7 的 series 与 metric 定义没有完全进入 caption。
Figure 4 只有 E-W2，不能独立支撑 all-metrics claim；Table 2–3 的最优变体也随 metric 和 dataset 变化。
Figure 11 caption 写 “Last three” 但实物是五个 test panels；Table 3 caption 的 2 × 10^5 与 Appendix D.1 的 10^4 wording 存在复现冲突。
FALCON 代码链接当前 404，baseline 仓的 plotting utilities 只能作为 contextual source，不能冒充 exact FALCON figure source。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以 biased-to-debiased flow 图建立 SNIS 与可逆 map 的因果骨架，用 ESS/W2/时间/NFE 表图绑定质量和成本，再以 train/test 构象热图、regularization/schedule 消融和 auxiliary reverse 曲线限定 few-step likelihood 的实践边界。
